e.summary: **ACLI（美国寿险协会）**（`www.acli.com`）**是美国**寿险业**的**行业协会入口****——**本次实测**：**⭐ 站点**返回 **200**、**45,144 字节****（**标签剥离后**文本 **3,729 字符**）**；**⭐ 首页**可核实**栏目**逐字**含 **ABOUT THE INDUSTRY**（**含 **INDUSTRY PRODUCTS、**WORKPLACE BENEFITS、**ECONOMIC INVESTMENTS、**REINSURANCE 与 **FINANCIAL STRENGTH）**、**「**LIFE INSURERS FACT BOOK**」（**寿险公司**事实手册）**、**「**STATE FACT SHEETS**」（**州级**情况说明）**、**「**ACLI Research**」**、**政策议题**（**逐字含 **PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE、**REGULATION、**RETIREMENT SECURITY 与 **TAXATION）**、**以及**媒体系**与**年会**（**逐字含 **ANNUAL CONFERENCE 2026）**；**⭐ 并**逐字**含一处**月度**出版物**「**FINANCIAL RESILIENCE INDEX - SEPTEMBER 2026**」**——**⭐ 即**站点**当期**仍在**更新**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**的**收尾**：**⭐ 人寿保险**类目**此前 **20 条**、**其中 **website 形态为 0****；**⭐ 而**协会与**统计**入口**一侧**池内**已有 **[[limra]]（**美国**寿险**研究）**、**[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、**[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、**[[fss-korea-insurance]] 与**上一轮**新收的 **[[kidi-insurance-statistics]]（**韩国）**——**⭐ 本条**补上的是**美国**行业协会**这一格**。**⭐⭐⭐ 三处最值得看**：**① **《**寿险公司**事实手册**》与**州级**情况说明**并**列**——**⭐ 即**同一套**行业**数据**既**有**全国**汇总**、**也**有**分州**切片**，**在**美国**这种**州级**监管**体系里**这**两种**口径**缺**一**不可**；**② **政策议题**被**单列**成**四个**可**跟踪**的**题目**（**带薪**家事与**医疗休假、**监管、**退休保障、**税制）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**若**你**要**做**监管**或**政策**功课**，**按**协会**列出的**议题**清单**去**追，**通常**比**从**新闻**倒推**更**完整**；**③ ⚠️ 而**首页**的**一部分**是**会员**与**活动**内容**（**逐字含 **Member Sign Up、**Member Login、**AFFILIATES、**RISING LEADER PROGRAM）**——**⭐ 即**它**不是**纯**数据**站**，**带**门**的**部分**需**自行**确认**可否**获取**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其任何**出版物**、**未使用**其**任何**数字**。

e.summary_en: This is the trade association gateway for the United States life insurance industry. **Measured this round**: the site returns two hundred with about forty-five kilobytes, or about thirty-seven hundred characters of text after stripping markup, and its home page names an industry section covering products, workplace benefits, economic investments, reinsurance, and financial strength, alongside a life insurers fact book, state fact sheets, association research, policy issues covering paid family and medical leave, regulation, retirement security, and taxation, a media section, and an annual conference. **It also carries a dated monthly publication, a financial resilience index for September of this year, which shows the site is current.** **This entry completes the round theme of targeted gap filling, because the life insurance category held twenty entries and none of them was a website, and although the site already held a United States life research body, the Japanese life association statistics, the Taiwan insurance centre, the Korean supervisory statistics, and the Korean development institute added in the previous round, this entry fills the American trade association slot.** **Three things are worth reading: the fact book and the state fact sheets sit side by side, so the same industry data exists both as a national aggregate and as state-level slices, and in a state-regulated market neither replaces the other; the policy issues are broken out into four trackable topics, which is a more complete way to follow policy work than reconstructing it from news; and part of the site is gated member and event content, so the closed portions need to be checked separately for access.** **No publication was downloaded and none of its figures was used this round.**
e.body:
**ACLI（美国寿险协会）**（`www.acli.com`）**是美国**寿险业**的**行业协会入口****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**按最薄类目定向补**」**的收尾**。

**可核实信息（均 2026-09-12 站点实测，本次未使用任何数据）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 《**寿险公司**事实手册**》与**州级**情况说明**并**列**，**而**这**在**州级**监管**体系里**有**实际**必要****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**含 **`LIFE INSURERS FACT BOOK`** 与 **`STATE FACT SHEETS`**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一点**对 RIAA **最实用**：**⭐ 即**美国**保险**监管**以**州**为单位**，**故**「**全国**口径**」**与**「**州**口径**」**同时**存在**——**⭐ 若**你**的**分析**只**用**全国**数字**，**则**在**费率**、**产品**与**合规**问题上**会**丢失**关键**差异**；**⭐ 对**写**政策**或**市场**功课**的人**，**先**确认**你**引用的**是**哪一**级**口径**。

**⭐⭐ ② 政策议题**被**拆**成**可**跟踪**的**题目**清单****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**列出**四个**议题**（**带薪**家事与**医疗休假、**监管、**退休保障**与**税制）**，**并**含 **`INDUSTRY EFFORTS`**（**含 **`CERTAINTY FOR AMERICANS`、**`FINANCIAL EDUCATION`、**`GRASSROOTS`）**与**新闻**分析**区块**（**逐字含 **`ALL PUBLICATIONS & RESEARCH`、**`MEDIA CONTACT`、**`NEWS RELEASES`）**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**协会**把**「**我们**在**推**什么**」**列**成**固定**栏目**，**这**对**外部**读者**是**低成本**的**政策**地图**——**⭐ 与之**相比**，**从**新闻**倒推**议题**往往**会**漏**掉**还没**上**新闻的**那条**。

**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 它**不是**纯**数据**站**，**部分**内容**带**门****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**含 **`Member Sign Up`、**`Member Login`、**`AFFILIATES`、**`RISING LEADER PROGRAM`** 与 **`ACLI LEARNING`**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**⭐ 即**「**有**公开**入口**」**与**「**内容**全部**公开**」**是**两件事**——**⭐ 与**本会话**此前**记下的**同类**情形**（**空壳**英文页、**登录墙**页）**一致**：**引用**机构**站点**时**要**逐项**标注**哪些是**公开**材料**、**哪些是**会员**材料**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 站点**当期**仍在**更新**（**可核对的**时点**证据）**——**⭐ 本次实测**：**首页**逐字**含**一处**月度**出版物**「**`FINANCIAL RESILIENCE INDEX - SEPTEMBER 2026`**」**与 **`ANNUAL CONFERENCE 2026`**；**⭐ 本词条**认为**：**⭐ 即**在**机构**站点**上**，**「**有**带**年月**的**当期**内容**」**是**判断**它**是否**还在**维护**的**最快**证据**——**⭐ 比**看**版权**年份**可靠**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[limra]] 覆盖**美国**寿险**研究**、**[[kidi-insurance-statistics]] 覆盖**韩国**费率与**统计**机构**、**[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]] 与 **[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、**[[fss-korea-insurance]] 覆盖**日台韩**统计**入口**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**美国**行业协会**＋**事实手册**与**州级**说明**」这一格**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先**确认**口径**层级**（**全国**／**州）**；**② **跟**议题**清单**而**不**只**跟**新闻**；**③ **分清**公开**材料**与**会员**材料**；**④ **用**带**年月**的**当期**content**判断**站点**是否**在**维护**；**⑤ **协会**入口**适合**做**行业**背景**，**而**不**适合**做**定价**依据**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**未下载**其任何**出版物**、**未使用**其**任何**数字****（**首页**文本**里**的**行业**叙述**与**文章**标题**均**未**作为**事实**引用）**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**首页**返回的**文本**（**标签**剥离**与**空白**归一**后 **3,729 字符**）**与**响应**字节数**，**未**遍历**站内**栏目页**、**未**登录**任何**会员**区**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**任一**出版物的**口径**、**更新**频率**与**再**分发**授权**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**会员**范围**与**与**任何**公司**的关系**。**⑤ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-12 所见**；**⚠️ 该站点**是**行业协会**信息**入口**，**不**是**保险产品**，**也**不**是**投资或**投保建议**。
e.body_hk:
**ACLI（美國壽險協會）**（`www.acli.com`）**是美國壽險業**的**行業協會入口****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**按最薄類目定向補**」**的收尾**。

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-12 站點實測，本次未使用任何數據）**：

**⭐⭐⭐ ① 事實手冊與州級情況說明並列****——**首頁逐字含 `LIFE INSURERS FACT BOOK` 與 `STATE FACT SHEETS`**；**⭐ 即**美國保險監管以州為單位**，**全國口徑與州口徑**同時存在**——**引用**時**先**確認**是哪一級**。

**⭐⭐ ② 政策議題被拆成可跟蹤題目****——**逐字列出**帶薪家事與醫療休假、**監管、**退休保障與**稅制**，**並含 `INDUSTRY EFFORTS`（`CERTAINTY FOR AMERICANS`、`FINANCIAL EDUCATION`、`GRASSROOTS`）**。

**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 部分內容帶門****——**逐字含 `Member Sign Up`、`Member Login`、`AFFILIATES`、`RISING LEADER PROGRAM` 與 `ACLI LEARNING`**；**⭐ 即**有公開入口不等於內容全部公開**。

**⭐⭐ ④ 站點當期仍在更新****——**逐字含**「**`FINANCIAL RESILIENCE INDEX - SEPTEMBER 2026`**」與 `ANNUAL CONFERENCE 2026`**；**⭐ 即**帶年月的當期內容**是**判斷**站點**是否**在**維護**的**最快**證據**。

**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[limra]]、[[kidi-insurance-statistics]]、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]、[[fss-korea-insurance]]——**⭐ 本條補上美國行業協會這一格**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **先確認口徑層級**；**② **跟議題清單**；**③ **分清公開與會員材料**；**④ **用帶年月內容判斷維護狀態**；**⑤ **協會入口做背景而非定價依據**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**未下載**其任何出版物、**未使用**其任何數字**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀首頁返回文本（**3,729 字符**）與響應位元組數**，**未遍歷站內欄目頁、**未登錄任何會員區**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其出版物的口徑、**更新頻率與**再分發授權**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其會員範圍與與任何公司的關係**。**⑤ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-12 所見**；**⚠️ 該站點是行業協會資訊入口**，**不是**保險產品**，**也**不是**投資或投保建議**。
e.body_en:
This is the trade association gateway for the United States life insurance industry. **This entry completes the round theme of targeted gap filling.**

**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-12 from the site itself, with no data used this round**:

**First, a life insurers fact book and state fact sheets sit side by side, which is necessary in a state-regulated system.** The home page names both. **Insurance regulation in the United States is organised by state, so national definitions and state definitions coexist, and an analysis that uses only the national figures will lose the differences that matter for rates, products, and compliance, which is why a reader doing policy or market work should first establish which level of definition a citation uses.**

**Second, policy issues are broken out into a trackable list.** The home page lists four topics covering paid family and medical leave, regulation, retirement security, and taxation, alongside an industry efforts section and a news and analysis section. **An association that lists what it is pushing for in fixed sections gives outside readers a low-cost policy map, and reconstructing the agenda from news will usually miss the item that has not yet become news.**

**Third, it is not a pure data site, since part of the content is gated.** The home page names member sign-up and login, an affiliates section, a rising leader programme, and a learning section. **Having a public entry point and having wholly public content are two different things, which matches the patterns recorded earlier in this session, such as an empty English page and a sign-in wall, so citing an institutional site means labelling which materials are public and which are for members.**

**Fourth, the site is demonstrably current.** The home page carries a dated monthly publication, a financial resilience index for September of this year, together with an annual conference for this year. **On an institutional site, dated current content is the fastest evidence that it is still maintained, and it is more reliable than reading the copyright year.**

**Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a United States life research body, the Korean rate-making and statistics institute added last round, and the Japanese, Taiwanese, and Korean statistics gateways, **while this entry fills the American trade association slot with its fact book and state fact sheets. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: establish which level of definition applies; follow an agenda list rather than only news; separate public from member materials; use dated content to judge whether a site is maintained; and treat an association gateway as background rather than as a pricing basis.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no publication was downloaded and no figure from the site is used here**, the industry narrative and article titles on the home page being recorded, not asserted. **Second, only the home page text, about thirty-seven hundred characters after stripping markup and normalising whitespace, and the response size were read**, and no inner page was traversed and no member area was accessed. **Third, the definitions, update frequency, and redistribution permissions of any publication were not verified.
